input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms (renewal length is fine) but contains no non-renewal notice mechanic at all; the only way out of a renewal is the general convenience right requiring ninety (90) days' written notice. That effective exit window exceeds the fallback of no more than 60 days, so the clause fails the fallback on a material term (though it stops short of walk-away, which is a window longer than 90 days or multi-year renewals). The redline inserts a 30-day non-renewal right, matching the preferred position, and leaves the existing 90-day convenience termination untouched. Note only: there is no renewal price-uplift language, so no CPI/3% cap is engaged — that is a rationale note rather than a separate deviation.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day non-renewal notice right to the auto-renewal sentence
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an express non-renewal right on thirty (30) days' notice before the end of each term, since today the only exit from an automatic renewal is ninety (90) days' notice, which is longer than our 30-day preferred (60-day fallback) window. We can live with 60 days if that works better for you.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term, or unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
